primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.title: Geschichte und Architektur des Kanzleramts
supports: Two office bands at 18 m surround a 36 m central cube; these official authoring anchors already belong to the retained scene.
Ehrenhof and the 5.5 m Chillida sculpture are distinct architectural elements.
primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.limit: Descriptive dimensions do not replace the full retained LoD2 sheets or establish new fitting measurements.

primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.title: Architektur des Paul-Löbe-Hauses
supports: The main entrance is on the west side; its large glass front reflects the opposite Chancellery.
The eastward view instead crosses the Spree toward the Marie-Elisabeth-Lüders library.
primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.limit: Establishes photo identity and relative orientation, not a newly surveyed canopy or column inventory.

primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.title: Bundeskanzleramt mit Ehrenhof
supports: Official exterior photo reference for the existing Ehrenhof composition.
primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.limit: Reference-only public image; no pixels, tracing, texture or metric extraction is bundled.

primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.title: Architektur des Marie-Elisabeth-Lüders-Hauses
supports: Marie-Elisabeth-Lüders-Haus is across the Spree from Paul-Löbe-Haus, with a library rotunda, circular opening and broad exterior stair.
primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.limit: The prospective extension paragraph is historical and is not current construction evidence for this task.

primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.title: Baumjournal 2024, Chancellery exterior planting reference
supports: Supplier description supports multi-stem umbrella planting at the Chancellery entrance.
primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.limit: Does not identify individual municipal catalogue points, exact plant dimensions or photographed stem counts.

primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.author: Tobias Chilla
primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.title: Natur-Elemente in der Stadtgestaltung, contents/excerpt of Kölner Geographische Arbeiten 85
supports: The figure-list caption associates Parthenocissus tricuspidata with the Chancellery entrance flanks.
primaryAndInstitutionalReferences.limit: Historical botanical context only, not a current site survey or proof that all photographed climbing cover is that species. The supplied PDF is a contents excerpt.

identityResolution.photos1And9: Paul-Löbe-Haus west entrance. Canopy/glass composition, opposite-Chancellery reflection, Reichstag to south and retained western source owner agree with the primary Bundestag west-entrance description.
identityResolution.notEstablishedInThesePhotos: The Marie-Elisabeth-Lüders-Haus across the Spree is a different retained site; photos 1/9 do not justify moving either building.

seasonAndBotany.photoAppearance: The supplied climbing leaves include red/orange autumn colour.
seasonAndBotany.requestedInterpretation: Green climbing cover follows the explicit owner instruction.
seasonAndBotany.geometryPolicy: Maintain irregular patch margins, bare stems, white gaps and clear openings rather than a continuous rectangular green curtain.
seasonAndBotany.botanyLimit: Do not claim evergreen Hedera helix from these images. Historical Parthenocissus context is compatible with autumn colour; all green presentation remains a requested seasonal interpretation.
seasonAndBotany.streetTrees: No authority to recolour every public tree, infer exact species from photos, move measured anchors or clear a photographic sightline.

retainedChancellerySignature.geometry_status: Metric recognition model from Berlin LoD2 extents and the official 36 m cube / 18 m office-band heights

heightDatum.courtyardStatus: Existing bounded entrance-profile estimate aligned with prior DGM context; retained unchanged.
heightDatum.warning: The scene anchor includes lower building geometry. It is not the exposed Ehrenhof pavement datum. Retain all original LoD2 source heights even where they differ from official 18/36 m recognition dimensions. No photo-based height correction is authorised.

boundedFacadeAssessment.sourceFrame: The two source/model office bands retain their original planes and scene rotation. The previous ivy and large authored panes followed a diagonal court-forward frame, visibly offset from these flat inner faces.
boundedFacadeAssessment.newRecognitionStatus: Thin pale fitting, louvred tall openings, companion narrow slits and patchy green cover are bounded photo-guided display estimates. The regular four bays per wing are not a surveyed complete window count.
boundedFacadeAssessment.observedOpeningCountLimit: Photos 2/5/7 contain three complete openings with cropped edge portions; perspective and cropping do not establish the full source opening inventory.
boundedFacadeAssessment.plantableUprights: Two already-authored 15.4 m colonnade end anchors only. The images do not establish wrapping all four 36 m leadership pylons. No new stone column is justified.
existingFeaturesRetained: Complete source masses, roof/end bounds and original source sheets
Central cube, concave roof, entrance canopy and existing colonnade
Existing lawns, grille, flags, Chillida sculpture and walking routes
Existing street furniture refined in v286
Unrelated earlier facade and winter-garden detail

permittedExactAuthoredTransfer.rule: Only exact frozen matrix/colour/geometry receipts may yield after complete guarded construction. The two reveal and two void owners are bounded inner-wing authored fittings; all other host instances and full source sheets remain.
